name: Feature Engineering
overview: This python program, written in a series of steps, was used to demonstrate feature engineering using git branches and basic data science practices using the Pandas package.
details:
The python program first reads in an excel file with clothing store inventory data on multiple tabs - a common format encountered in the federal government - using Pandas, and then counts rows and columns per tab. This program was first committed to the main branch. Two separate feature engineering branches (inventory_analysis_branch1 & ...2) were then created in the command line. In both of these branches, a separate analysis was conducted. The first feature (inventory_analysis_feature1) added calculated values to the dataframes. This feature was then accepted and merged into the main branch. Additional work was done with the main branch to create summary statistics using the calculated values, which were committed changes. Then features 2 was merged to the main branch. Feature 2 (inventory_analysis_feature2) calculated summary statistics based on the category of clothing. Feature 3 (inventory_analysis_feature3) was created to stack (via rows) the datasets together. This feature was then pushed to the main branch. 


This program also demonstrates the use of dictionaries, lists, tuples, Pandas.DataFrames, and Pandas.Series.
